about_short_description.short_description: Hoop.dev provides secure access gateway controlling infrastructure, masking data, and automating compliance workflows.

product.name: Privileged Access Management Platform
product.description: A platform that provides secure, just-in-time privileged access to databases and servers, replacing shared credentials and manual approvals with automated policies and session recording.

product.name: AI-Powered Real-Time Data Masking
product.description: A service that uses machine learning to automatically identify and redact sensitive data in real-time across database and Kubernetes connections without manual policy configuration.

product.name: Developer Tools with AI Assistance
product.description: Tools including an AI Copilot and AI Query Builder that assist developers in building queries and scripts securely within their existing workflows.

identifier.value: Infrastructure Automation with Runbooks and GitOps

product.name: Infrastructure Automation with Runbooks and GitOps
product.description: Automation features that transform manual security processes into automated workflows using integrated runbooks and GitOps practices.

product.name: Session Recording and Audit Logging
product.description: A system that records all access sessions and logs commands and queries to provide full visibility for security audits and investigations.
